name: pendesk-client
description: PenDesk Desktop Client - Cross-Platform Remote Desktop (Tauri v2 + WebRTC)

scripts.dev:ui: node -e "require('http').createServer((req,res) => { const fs=require('fs'), path=require('path'); let p=req.url==='/'?'/index.html':req.url; try { const mime = p.endsWith('.css')?'text/css':p.endsWith('.js')?'application/javascript':'text/html'; res.writeHead(200,{'Content-Type':mime}); fs.createReadStream(path.join('src',p)).pipe(res); } catch(e){res.writeHead(404);res.end();} }).listen(3000,()=>console.log('UI Preview running at http://localhost:3000'))"

author: Penrose Systems
